about: The content requests of the scored authoring test (docs/PLAN.md items 9.4 and 9.5): each is given to a test session in a fresh copy of its base mod, and what the session leaves is graded by the checker, by the expectations below (in code) and by a judge on the judged dimensions. fixtures/requests/README.md says what every field means.

dimensions.what: The effects the result runs are the ones the request asks for, with the amounts it names.
The conditions hold exactly when the request says, no more and no less.
Each effect and condition applies to the character the request names.
The localization says what the request describes, in readable English, each text fitting what it is shown for.
The result adds or changes nothing the request did not ask for that changes the game.

requests.request: Write a character event (`character_event`) with the id `authoring_merchant.0001` in a new file under `events/`, in the namespace `authoring_merchant`. A merchant comes back to repay an old debt to the character. The event has a title, a description and two options: the first gives the character 100 gold (`add_gold`), the second gives 50 prestige (`add_prestige`) instead. Write its English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: the title `authoring_merchant.0001.t`, the description `authoring_merchant.0001.desc` and the two options `authoring_merchant.0001.a` and `authoring_merchant.0001.b`.

judged.question: Does the first option give the character 100 gold and the second 50 prestige, each that and nothing else?
Do the title, the description and the two options tell of a merchant repaying an old debt, each option's text fitting what it does?
Does the result add nothing that changes the game beyond the one event and its localization (no other effect, condition, event or record)?

requests.request: Write a character event (`character_event`) with the id `authoring_sleep.0001` in a new file under `events/`, in the namespace `authoring_sleep`: the character cannot sleep. It may happen only to an adult (`is_adult`) who is not imprisoned (`is_imprisoned`) and whose stress is at least 50 (`stress`). It has three options. The first lowers the character's stress by 20 (`add_stress`) and takes 25 gold from the character (`add_gold`). The second gives 25 piety (`add_piety`) and lowers stress by 10. The third is shown only to a character with at least 100 prestige (`prestige`); it lowers stress by 30 and takes 50 prestige from the character (`add_prestige`). Write its English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: `authoring_sleep.0001.t`, `authoring_sleep.0001.desc`, `authoring_sleep.0001.a`, `authoring_sleep.0001.b` and `authoring_sleep.0001.c`.

judged.question: Can the event happen only to an adult who is not imprisoned and has at least 50 stress, and is the third option shown only to a character with at least 100 prestige?
Does each option change stress, gold, piety and prestige by exactly the amounts the request gives it, and nothing else?
Do the texts tell of a character who cannot sleep, each option's text fitting what it does?

requests.request: Write two character events (`character_event`) in a new file under `events/`, in the namespace `authoring_letter`. The first, `authoring_letter.0001`, comes once a year through the on-action `yearly_playable_pulse`, which you hook in a new file under `common/on_action/`; it may happen only to a ruler (`is_ruler`) who is married (`is_married`): a letter arrives from the character's spouse. Its one option gives the character 10 piety (`add_piety`) and fires the second event, `authoring_letter.0002`, 3 days later (`trigger_event`). In the second event the character answers: one option gives the character's spouse (`primary_spouse`) 20 prestige (`add_prestige`), the other lowers the character's own stress by 10 (`add_stress`). Write the English localization of both events in a new file under `localization/english/`: `authoring_letter.0001.t`, `authoring_letter.0001.desc`, `authoring_letter.0001.a`, `authoring_letter.0002.t`, `authoring_letter.0002.desc`, `authoring_letter.0002.a` and `authoring_letter.0002.b`.

judged.question: Does the first event come through the yearly on-action, and can it happen only to a ruler who is married?
Does the first event's option give 10 piety and fire the second event 3 days later, and do the second event's two options give 20 prestige and lower stress by 10?
Are the 20 prestige given to the character's spouse, and the 10 piety and the lower stress to the character?
Do the texts tell of a letter from the spouse and of the character's answer, each option's text fitting what it does?

requests.request: Write a decision `authoring_alms_decision` in a new file under `common/decisions/`. It is shown to rulers (`is_ruler`) and can be taken only with at least 100 gold (`gold`). Taking it takes 100 gold from the character (`add_gold`) and gives 50 piety (`add_piety`). Write its English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: the title `authoring_alms_decision` and the description `authoring_alms_decision_desc`.

judged.question: Is the decision shown only to rulers, and can it be taken only with at least 100 gold?
Does taking the decision take 100 gold from the character and give 50 piety, and nothing else?
Do the title and the description say what the decision is and does?

requests.request: Write a decision `authoring_vigil_decision` in a new file under `common/decisions/`, with the event it fires. The decision is shown to adults (`is_adult`), can be taken only by a character who is not at war (`is_at_war`), and can be taken again only 3 years after it was last taken (`cooldown`). The AI takes it seldom: its `ai_will_do` has a base of 10. Taking it fires, 5 days later (`trigger_event`), the character event (`character_event`) `authoring_vigil.0001`, which you write in a new file under `events/`, in the namespace `authoring_vigil`: the vigil ends at dawn, and the event's one option gives 25 piety (`add_piety`). Write the English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: `authoring_vigil_decision`, `authoring_vigil_decision_desc`, `authoring_vigil.0001.t`, `authoring_vigil.0001.desc` and `authoring_vigil.0001.a`.

judged.question: Is the decision shown only to adults, can it be taken only by a character not at war, and can it be taken again only 3 years later?
Does taking the decision fire the event 5 days later, does the event's one option give 25 piety, and does the AI weigh the decision with a base of 10?
Do the decision's texts describe a night vigil, and do the event's texts tell of the vigil ending at dawn?

requests.request: The mod in this folder already has the scripted trigger `banquet_can_host_trigger`, the scripted effect `banquet_host_reward_effect` and the character event `banquet.0001`. Write a decision `authoring_hold_banquet_decision` in a new file under `common/decisions/` that uses them. It is shown to characters for whom `banquet_can_host_trigger` holds, and can be taken only with at least 100 gold (`gold`). Taking it takes 100 gold from the character (`add_gold`), runs `banquet_host_reward_effect`, and fires `banquet.0001` 7 days later (`trigger_event`). It can be taken again only 5 years after it was last taken (`cooldown`). Write its English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: the title `authoring_hold_banquet_decision` and the description `authoring_hold_banquet_decision_desc`. Change none of the mod's other files.

judged.question: Is the decision shown only where the mod's banquet_can_host_trigger holds, can it be taken only with at least 100 gold, and can it be taken again only 5 years later?
Does taking the decision take 100 gold from the character, run banquet_host_reward_effect and fire banquet.0001 7 days later?
Do the title and the description say what the decision is and does?
Are the mod's other files unchanged, and does the result add nothing that changes the game beyond the decision and its localization?

requests.request: Write a scripted effect `authoring_reward_effect` in a new file under `common/scripted_effects/`. It gives the character it runs on 50 gold (`add_gold`) and 25 prestige (`add_prestige`).

judged.question: Does the effect give the character it runs on 50 gold and 25 prestige?
Does the effect do nothing else, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: Write a scripted effect `authoring_war_chest_effect` in a new file under `common/scripted_effects/`, for a character. When the character is at war (`is_at_war`) it gives 100 gold (`add_gold`); otherwise it gives 50 prestige (`add_prestige`): write it with `if` and `else`. Either way it then raises the character's stress by 5 (`add_stress`).

judged.question: Is the gold given only when the character is at war, and the prestige only when it is not?
Does the effect give 100 gold or 50 prestige as the request says, and raise stress by 5 in both cases?
Does the effect do nothing else, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: Write two scripted effects in a new file under `common/scripted_effects/`, for a character. `authoring_children_gift_effect` gives each of the character's children who is an adult (`every_child`, `is_adult`) 25 gold (`add_gold`), and then gives the character 20 prestige (`add_prestige`). `authoring_family_feast_effect` runs `authoring_children_gift_effect` and then lowers the character's stress by 15 (`add_stress`).

judged.question: Do only the children who are adults get the gold?
Does the first effect give 25 gold and 20 prestige, and does the second run the first and then lower stress by 15?
Is the gold given to each adult child, and the prestige and the lower stress to the character itself, once each?
Do the two effects do nothing else, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: Write a scripted trigger `authoring_can_host_trigger` in a new file under `common/scripted_triggers/`. It holds for a character who is an adult (`is_adult`), is a ruler (`is_ruler`) and has at least 50 gold (`gold`).

judged.question: Does the trigger hold exactly for an adult ruler with at least 50 gold?
Does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: Write a scripted trigger `authoring_family_ready_trigger` in a new file under `common/scripted_triggers/`, for a character. It holds when the character is married (`is_married`) or has at least one child who is an adult (`any_child`, `is_adult`), and in either case is not imprisoned (`is_imprisoned`).

judged.question: Does the trigger hold exactly when the character is married or has an adult child, and is not imprisoned?
Is being an adult tested on the child, and being married and not imprisoned on the character?

requests.request: The mod in this folder already has the character event `banquet.0001`. Write a scripted trigger `authoring_banquet_guest_trigger` in a new file under `common/scripted_triggers/`, for a character: it holds for an adult (`is_adult`) who is not at war (`is_at_war`) and whose liege (`liege`) is a ruler (`is_ruler`) with at least 100 gold (`gold`). Then let `banquet.0001` happen only to characters for whom the new trigger holds, by adding it to that event's trigger and keeping what is there. Change nothing else in the mod.

judged.question: Does the trigger hold exactly for an adult not at war whose liege is a ruler with at least 100 gold, and does banquet.0001 now need the trigger as well as what its trigger held before?
Are being a ruler and the 100 gold tested on the liege, and being an adult and not at war on the character?
Is banquet.0001 otherwise unchanged, are the mod's other files unchanged, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: The mod in this folder already has the character event `granary.0001` and a scripted effect that thanks a vassal who keeps a granary. Write a second character event (`character_event`), `granary.0002`, in a new file under `events/`, in the mod's own namespace: the character rides out to inspect the granaries. It has two options. The first runs the mod's scripted effect that thanks a vassal on each of the character's vassals (`every_vassal`) who is an adult (`is_adult`): find that effect and use it, do not write what it does again. The second lowers the character's stress by 15 (`add_stress`). Then make the one option of `granary.0001` also fire `granary.0002` 10 days later (`trigger_event`), keeping everything else of `granary.0001` as it is. Write the English localization of the new event in a new file under `localization/english/`: `granary.0002.t`, `granary.0002.desc`, `granary.0002.a` and `granary.0002.b`. Change nothing else in the mod.

judged.question: Does the first option of granary.0002 run the mod's scripted effect that thanks a vassal, and the second lower the character's stress by 15, and does granary.0001's option now also fire granary.0002 10 days later?
Is the mod's effect run on each of the character's vassals who is an adult, and is the stress lowered for the character?
Do the new event's texts tell of the character riding out to inspect the granaries, each option's text fitting what it does?
Is granary.0001 otherwise unchanged, are the mod's other files unchanged, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: Write an envoy's visit as four pieces that use each other. A scripted trigger `authoring_envoy_host_trigger`, in a new file under `common/scripted_triggers/`, holds for a ruler (`is_ruler`) who is an adult (`is_adult`) and not at war (`is_at_war`). A scripted effect `authoring_envoy_gift_effect`, in a new file under `common/scripted_effects/`, gives the character it runs on 30 gold (`add_gold`) and 10 prestige (`add_prestige`). Two character events (`character_event`), in a new file under `events/`, in the namespace `authoring_envoy`. The first, `authoring_envoy.0001`, may happen only to characters for whom `authoring_envoy_host_trigger` holds: an envoy arrives at court. Its one option picks one of the character's courtiers who is an adult (`random_courtier`), saves that courtier as the scope named envoy (`save_scope_as`), and fires `authoring_envoy.0002` for the character 5 days later (`trigger_event`). In `authoring_envoy.0002` the character sends the envoy home: its first option runs `authoring_envoy_gift_effect` on the envoy the first event saved, not on the character; its second gives the character 20 piety (`add_piety`). Write the English localization of both events in a new file under `localization/english/`: `authoring_envoy.0001.t`, `authoring_envoy.0001.desc`, `authoring_envoy.0001.a`, `authoring_envoy.0002.t`, `authoring_envoy.0002.desc`, `authoring_envoy.0002.a` and `authoring_envoy.0002.b`.

judged.question: Can the first event happen only to characters for whom authoring_envoy_host_trigger holds, and does that trigger hold exactly for an adult ruler not at war?
Does the gift effect give 30 gold and 10 prestige, does the first event's option fire the second event 5 days later, and does the second event's second option give 20 piety?
Is the courtier the first event saves the one the gift effect runs on in the second event, and is the second event fired for the character, who gets the 20 piety?
Do the texts tell of an envoy arriving at court and being sent home, each option's text fitting what it does?

requests.request: Write a character event (`character_event`) `authoring_unrest.0001` in a new file under `events/`, in the namespace `authoring_unrest`: unrest in one of the counties of a ruler's realm. It may happen only to a ruler (`is_ruler`) with at least one county in their sub-realm (`any_sub_realm_county`) whose people's opinion of their holder is below -20. When it happens (`immediate`), it picks one such county (`random_sub_realm_county`) and saves it as the scope named unrest_county (`save_scope_as`). The first option raises that county's control by 20 (`change_county_control`) and takes 50 gold from the character (`add_gold`). The second raises the opinion of that county's people of their holder by 10, and takes 25 prestige from the character (`add_prestige`). Write its English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: `authoring_unrest.0001.t`, `authoring_unrest.0001.desc`, `authoring_unrest.0001.a` and `authoring_unrest.0001.b`.

judged.question: Can the event happen only to a ruler with a county of their sub-realm whose people's opinion of their holder is below -20, and is the county it picks always one such county?
Does the first option raise the county's control by 20 and take 50 gold, and the second raise its people's opinion of their holder by 10 and take 25 prestige?
Are the control and the opinion changed on the county the event picked, and the gold and the prestige taken from the character?
Do the texts tell of unrest in one of the ruler's counties, each option's text fitting what it does?

requests.request: The mod in this folder already has a scripted trigger for a ruler with the gold to pay for new granaries, a scripted effect that pays for them, and a scripted effect that rewards a ruler who keeps the granaries full. Write a decision `authoring_fund_granaries_decision` in a new file under `common/decisions/`. It is shown to rulers (`is_ruler`), and can be taken only when the mod's trigger for paying holds. Taking it runs the mod's effect that pays, and then the mod's effect that rewards. Find the mod's own trigger and effects and use them: do not write their conditions or effects again. It can be taken again only 10 years after it was last taken (`cooldown`). Write its English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: the title `authoring_fund_granaries_decision` and the description `authoring_fund_granaries_decision_desc`. Change none of the mod's files.

judged.question: Is the decision shown only to rulers, can it be taken only when the mod's trigger for paying for granaries holds, and can it be taken again only 10 years later?
Does taking the decision run the mod's effect that pays for granaries and then the mod's effect that rewards, and nothing else?
Do the title and the description say what the decision is and does?
Are the mod's files unchanged, and does the result add nothing beyond the decision and its localization that changes the game?

requests.request: Write a decision `authoring_pardon_decision` in a new file under `common/decisions/`: a ruler pardons their prisoners. It is shown to rulers (`is_ruler`), and can be taken only by a ruler who is at peace and holds at least one prisoner (`any_prisoner`). Taking it takes 25 gold from the ruler (`add_gold`), and then sets free each of the ruler's prisoners (`every_prisoner`) who is an adult (`is_adult`), lowering each freed prisoner's stress by 10 (`add_stress`). It can be taken again only 5 years later (`cooldown`), and the AI takes it with a base weight of 5 (`ai_will_do`). Write its English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: the title `authoring_pardon_decision` and the description `authoring_pardon_decision_desc`.

judged.question: Is the decision shown only to rulers, can it be taken only at peace and while the ruler holds at least one prisoner, and can it be taken again only 5 years later?
Does taking it take 25 gold, set free each adult prisoner and lower each one's stress by 10, and does the AI weigh it with a base of 5?
Is the gold taken from the ruler, once, and are the freeing and the lower stress given to each adult prisoner?
Do the title and the description say what the decision is and does?

requests.request: Write a decision `authoring_house_feast_decision` in a new file under `common/decisions/`, with the event it fires: a ruler feasts the members of their house. It is shown to rulers (`is_ruler`), and can be taken only when the power score of the character's house (`house`) is at least 50 and the character has at least 75 gold (`gold`). Taking it takes 75 gold from the character (`add_gold`), gives each member of the character's house (`every_house_member`) who is an adult (`is_adult`) 10 prestige (`add_prestige`), and fires for the character, 3 days later (`trigger_event`), the character event (`character_event`) `authoring_house_feast.0001`, which you write in a new file under `events/`, in the namespace `authoring_house_feast`: the feast ends, and the event's one option gives 15 piety (`add_piety`). Write the English localization in a new file under `localization/english/`: `authoring_house_feast_decision`, `authoring_house_feast_decision_desc`, `authoring_house_feast.0001.t`, `authoring_house_feast.0001.desc` and `authoring_house_feast.0001.a`.

judged.question: Is the decision shown only to rulers, and can it be taken only when the character's house has a power score of at least 50 and the character at least 75 gold?
Does taking it take 75 gold, give 10 prestige to each adult member of the house and fire the event 3 days later, and does the event's option give 15 piety?
Is the power score tested on the character's house, the prestige given to each adult member of it, and the gold taken from and the event fired for the character?
Do the decision's texts describe a feast for the house, and do the event's texts tell of the feast ending?

requests.request: Write a scripted effect `authoring_realm_relief_effect` in a new file under `common/scripted_effects/`, run on a ruler. For each county of the ruler's sub-realm (`every_sub_realm_county`) whose county control is below 50 (`county_control`), it raises that county's control by 10 (`change_county_control`) and gives the character who holds that county 10 gold (`add_gold`). Then, once, it takes 25 prestige from the ruler (`add_prestige`).

judged.question: Are only the counties of the sub-realm whose county control is below 50 changed?
Does the effect raise each such county's control by 10, give 10 gold for each, and take 25 prestige once?
Is the control raised on each county, the gold given to that county's holder, and the prestige taken from the ruler, once?
Does the effect do nothing else, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: The mod in this folder already has the scripted effect `granary_vassal_gift_effect`, which gives the vassal it runs on 20 gold, in a file with two other scripted effects. Change it in place, in that file: it should give the 20 gold (`add_gold`) only when the vassal's opinion of their liege (`opinion`, with the vassal's `liege` as its target) is at least 30, and otherwise give the vassal 10 prestige (`add_prestige`), written with `if` and `else`. Leave the file's other scripted effects exactly as they are, and change none of the mod's other files.

judged.question: Does the effect give the gold only when the vassal's opinion of their liege is at least 30, and the prestige otherwise?
Does it give 20 gold or 10 prestige as the request says, and nothing else?
Is the opinion tested as the vassal's opinion of their liege, not the liege's opinion of the vassal, and are the gold and the prestige given to the vassal?
Are the file's other scripted effects and the mod's other files unchanged, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: Write a scripted effect `authoring_heir_household_effect` in a new file under `common/scripted_effects/`, for a ruler. If the ruler has a primary heir (`primary_heir`), it gives that heir 50 gold (`add_gold`) and gives each of the heir's own siblings (`every_sibling`) who is an adult (`is_adult`) 10 prestige (`add_prestige`): the siblings of the heir, reached from the heir, not the ruler's own siblings. Whether or not there is an heir, it then lowers the ruler's stress by 10 (`add_stress`).

judged.question: Are the gold and the prestige given only when the ruler has a primary heir, the prestige only to siblings who are adults, and is the stress lowered whether or not there is an heir?
Does the effect give 50 gold, 10 prestige to each such sibling, and lower stress by 10?
Is the gold given to the heir, the prestige to each adult sibling of the heir, and the lower stress to the ruler?
Does the effect do nothing else, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: Write a scripted trigger `authoring_loyal_realm_trigger` in a new file under `common/scripted_triggers/`, for a ruler. It holds when at least 3 counties of the ruler's sub-realm (`any_sub_realm_county`) each have a county control of at least 50 (`county_control`) and people whose opinion of their holder is at least 20, the same 3 counties meeting both.

judged.question: Does the trigger hold exactly when at least 3 counties of the ruler's sub-realm each have county control of at least 50 and an opinion of their holder of at least 20, the same counties meeting both?
Are the county control and the opinion tested on the counties, not on the ruler?
Does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: The mod in this folder already has two scripted triggers: one for a ruler with the gold to pay for new granaries, and one for a ruler free to ride out to see them. Write a scripted trigger `authoring_granary_patron_trigger` in a new file under `common/scripted_triggers/`, for a character. It holds when the mod's trigger for a ruler free to ride out holds for the character, and the mod's trigger for paying holds for at least two of the character's vassals (`any_vassal`). Find the two triggers and use them: do not write their conditions again. Change none of the mod's files.

judged.question: Does the trigger hold exactly when the mod's trigger for riding out holds for the character and the mod's trigger for paying holds for at least two of its vassals?
Is the trigger for riding out tested on the character, and the one for paying on the vassals?
Are the mod's files unchanged, and does the result add nothing else that changes the game?

requests.request: Write a scripted trigger `authoring_settled_ruler_trigger` in a new file under `common/scripted_triggers/`, for a ruler. It holds when the ruler is at peace, is married, and has at least two children who are adults, and the ruler's primary heir (`primary_heir`) is an adult (`is_adult`) who is not imprisoned (`is_imprisoned`).

judged.question: Does the trigger hold exactly when the ruler is at peace, is married and has at least two adult children, and the primary heir is an adult who is not imprisoned?
Are being at peace and being married tested on the ruler, being an adult on the children, and being an adult and not imprisoned on the heir?

retired.why: Its base mod defined the event feast.0001, an id the base game's own events/activities/feast_activity/feast_events.txt defines: definitions/clash, an error no result could avoid while changing none of the mod's files (the first scored authoring run, 2026-11-24). Replaced by decision-hold-banquet, on the base banquet.

Its base mod defined the event feast.0001, an id the base game's own events/activities/feast_activity/feast_events.txt defines: definitions/clash, an error no result could avoid without renaming the event it was asked to change (the first scored authoring run, 2026-11-24). Replaced by trigger-banquet-guest, on the base banquet.
